items.headline: 'We Don't Have Decades': Why $500 Million Won't Break China's Grip on Batteries
items.snippet: Albemarle Q2 beat estimates: adjusted EPS $3.75 on $1.74B revenue; management now expects high end of $20/kg LCE scenario, full-year sales $5.7-6B. Stationary storage ~30% of 2026 global lithium demand per ALB. Q2 realized lithium price $19.53/kg LCE.

items.headline: Market Chatter: Lithium Miners' Profits Surge as Battery Storage Demand Drives Prices Higher
items.snippet: Chinese lithium producers Tianqi and Ganfeng posted strongest H1 net income in 3 years. China spot lithium prices up 22% YTD amid tight inventories. Albemarle noted global lithium demand grew 45% through May, significantly outstripping supply.
